headline: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa authorities said on Sunday Pakistan is weighing 'faceless' courts and Rs70 billion ($253 million) for security in the province, including Rs59.8 billion for police and Rs10.3 billion for the Counter-Terrorism Department, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Judges aur gawahon ki shanakht chhupa kar muqadmat ki tajweez

caption:
KP ki security ke liye Rs70 billion ka plan!
Arab News ke mutabiq Sunday ko hukaam ne bataya ke Khyber Pakhtunkhwa mein "faceless" courts par ghaur ho raha hai, jin mein judges aur gawahon ki shanakht zahir kiye baghair criminal muqadmat chalenge. "Strong Khyber Pakhtunkhwa" plan mein Rs70 billion rakhe gaye hain: Rs59.8 billion police aur Rs10.3 billion CTD ke liye.
Kya is se KP mein aman behtar hoga? Comment mein batayein 👇
